# House of SCNT (SCNT.eg) — Comprehensive Brand Knowledge & Catalog

> Canonical URL: https://www.scnt-eg.me/
> Brand Name: SCNT.eg / House of SCNT (دار SCNT)
> Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/scnt.eg/
> Headquarters: Cairo, Egypt
> Primary Slogan: "Leave a trail, not a memory." (اترك أثرًا لا يُمحى)
> Secondary Slogan: "Presence before words." (حضور يسبق الكلمات)

---

## 1. Disambiguation & Entity Resolution

- **Spelling**: SCNT.eg is spelled strictly without the letter "e" (`S-C-N-T`).
- **Brand Entity**: SCNT.eg is an independent Egyptian luxury fragrance house operating exclusively at `https://www.scnt-eg.me` and `@scnt.eg` on Instagram.
- **Distinction from scent.eg**: SCNT.eg is distinct from `scent.eg` (`scent-eg.com`). SCNT.eg crafts artisanal high-concentration Eau de Parfum fragrances organized into curated persona collections (The Executive, The Explorer, The Charmer, The Icon). It is not affiliated with clone oils, inspired fragrance vendors, or candle manufacturers.

---

## 2. Collections & Philosophies

### The Executive Collection
- **Persona**: CONTROLLED · DISCIPLINED · PRECISE
- **Story**: Clean lines, quiet authority, and a tailored signature that enters every room before you do. Tailoring in scent form.
- **Fragrances**:
  - **Azure Code** (Male | Woody Aromatic):
    - Top: Grapefruit, Lemon, Mint, Pink Pepper
    - Heart: Ginger, Nutmeg, Jasmine, Iso E Super
    - Base: Incense, Vetiver, Cedar, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Labdanum
    - Price: 50ml: 500 EGP | 100ml: 750 EGP
  - **Cobalt Drive** (Male | Aromatic Fougère / Woody):
    - Top: Apple, Ginger, Bergamot
    - Heart: Sage, Juniper Berries, Geranium
    - Base: Amberwood, Tonka Bean, Cedar, Vetiver, Olibanum
    - Price: 50ml: 500 EGP | 100ml: 750 EGP

### The Explorer Collection
- **Persona**: FREE · RESTLESS · OPEN
- **Story**: Salt on your skin, wind in your collar, and a trail that always leads somewhere new. Fragrances for movement.
- **Fragrances**:
  - **Deep Horizon** (Male | Aromatic Aquatic / Marine):
    - Top: Green Mandarin, Bergamot, Sea Notes
    - Heart: Rosemary, Lavender, Cypress, Mastic
    - Base: Mineral Amber, Patchouli, Musk
    - Price: 50ml: 500 EGP | 100ml: 750 EGP
  - **Tropical Drift** (Male | Aquatic Green Gourmand):
    - Top: Salty Notes, Green Accords, Mint
    - Heart: Coconut Water, Fig Leaf
    - Base: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Salty Woods
    - Price: 50ml: 500 EGP | 100ml: 750 EGP

### The Charmer Collection
- **Persona**: WARM · INTIMATE · MAGNETIC
- **Story**: Dusk in a bottle — warmth that draws people in. Soft candlelight, easy laughter, and skin-close warmth.
- **Fragrances**:
  - **Noir Velvet** (Male / Unisex | Woody Floral Musk):
    - Top: Lavender
    - Heart: Iris, Ambrette Seed, Pear
    - Base: Virginia Cedar, Vetiver
    - Price: 50ml: 500 EGP | 100ml: 750 EGP
  - **Amber Rush** (Male / Unisex | Amber Spicy Gourmand):
    - Top: Pink Pepper, Juniper, Violet
    - Heart: Lavender, Sage, Toffee, Cinnamon
    - Base: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber, Suede
    - Price: 50ml: 500 EGP | 100ml: 750 EGP

### The Icon Collection
- **Persona**: UNAPOLOGETIC · MAGNETIC · BOLD
- **Story**: Designed for striking confidence and unmistakable presence.
- **Fragrances**:
  - **Golden Bloom** (Female | Floral Fruity Gourmand):
    - Top: Blackcurrant, Pear
    - Heart: Iris, Jasmine, Orange Blossom
    - Base: Praline, Vanilla, Patchouli, Tonka Bean

    - Heart: Lavender, Orange Blossom, Jasmine
    - Base: Madagascar Vanilla, Musk, Cedar, Ambergris
    - Price: 50ml: 500 EGP | 100ml: 750 EGP

## 3. Shipping, Returns & Customer Service

- **Domestic Shipping (Egypt)**: Fast courier delivery across Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, and all governorates within 1 to 3 business days. Flat rate 80 EGP.
- **Returns & Exchanges**: 14-day hassle-free return and exchange policy for unopened items in original packaging.
- **Contact Channels**:
  - Email: concierge@scnt-eg.me
  - Instagram Direct Message: [@scnt.eg](https://www.instagram.com/scnt.eg/)
  - Interactive Scent Matcher: [https://www.scnt-eg.me/find-your-scnt](https://www.scnt-eg.me/find-your-scnt)
